 Highlights Today’s matches, Monday, November 2, 2026, UAE time, and the broadcasting channels 
 AFC Champions League Elite 
 Egyptian League Cup 
 Premier League 
 Spanish League 
 Football fans are looking forward to a series of important matches in continental and local tournaments on Monday, November 2, 2026, most notably the AFC Champions League matches, along with Egyptian League Cup matches, and matches in the English and Spanish leagues.
 The AFC Champions League is attracting widespread attention, with a number of prominent matches, most notably Al Ain vs Al Ittihad of Saudi Arabia, Al Nassr of Saudi Arabia vs Pakhtakor, as well as Al Sadd of Qatar vs Al Ahli Jeddah, on a day that will witness multiple matches at the continental championship level.
 In Egypt, attention is focused on the League Cup matches, as Zamalek meets Wadi Degla in a match where the White team seeks to achieve victory and enhance its chances in the competition, while Al-Ahly faces its counterpart Al-Mokawloon Al-Arab, in a test in which both teams look forward to delivering a strong performance and coming out with a positive result.
 At the European league level, Newcastle United hosts Everton in the English Premier League, while Deportivo La Coruña meets Osasuna in a match included in today’s schedule.
 Today’s matches, Monday, November 2, 2026, UAE time, and the broadcasting channels
 AFC Champions League Elite
 Pakhtakor vs Al-Nassr Saudi Arabia: 5:45 PM UAE time, via beIN SPORTS 2.
 Tractor vs Neftchi Fergana: 8:00 PM UAE time, via beIN SPORTS 3.
 Al Wasl vs Al Quwa Al Jawiya: 8:00 PM UAE time, via beIN SPORTS 2.
 Al Sadd of Qatar vs Al Ahli Jeddah: 8:00 PM UAE time, via beIN SPORTS 1.
 Al Gharafa vs Al Qadsia: 10:15 PM UAE time, via beIN SPORTS 1.
 Al-Ittihad Saudi vs Al-Ain: 10:15 PM UAE time, via beIN SPORTS 3.
 Egyptian League Cup
 Zamalek vs Wadi Degla: 6:00 PM UAE time, on ON Sport MAX channel
 Al Ahly of Egypt vs Al Mokawloon Al Arab: 9:00 PM UAE time, via ON Sport HD channel.
 Premier League
 Newcastle United vs Everton: 11:00 PM UAE time, via beIN Sports 2 HD.
 Spanish League
 Deportivo La Coruña vs Osasuna: 11:00 PM UAE time, via beIN Sports 4 HD.
